name: How fishing works
summary: IGN's step-by-step for fishing: the rod is always carried, Focus shows where fish are, and a fish is tired out before reeling in.
body: IGN says fishing can be done almost anywhere a line can be cast, at any time, though a tutorial comes in the Chapter 1 main mission Recalibration.
IGN says the Fishing Rod is always in the inventory, in the same loadout slot as the Binoculars and Flashlight (below Unarmed), and is selected by holding L1/LB and cycling with L2/LT or R2/RT.

IGN's method: choose a lure with Left and Right on the D-pad, use Focus to see fish glowing in the water, hold L2/LT to aim, draw back with R2/RT to set the cast's strength, and reel slowly with the right stick.

IGN says the first light rumble is only a nibble; on a stronger shake, R2/RT hooks the fish, the left stick is pushed against its direction to tire it, and fast reeling starts once the rumbling eases.

IGN says Cal texts fishing record challenges that put a purple fish icon on the map; the first, Catch a Bigger Fish in Chapter 1, asks for a Stoplight Parrotfish over 2 lb, and Cross (A) sends him a photo of the catch.
IGN says fishing gives a Focus boost and that Focus gains, unlike Strength and Cardio, are permanent.

facts.location: Any water a line can be cast into

name: Crashed plane south of Hamlet
summary: A small plane comes down in a field south of Hamlet early on; IGN says it holds a pistol and drugs, and armed men follow.
body: IGN says smoke from a field south of Hamlet marks a crashed plane with a dead pilot, and that the plane can sometimes be seen losing control from the bridge between Key Lento and Hamlet.
IGN says a pistol and drugs lie around the wreck, Focus picks them out, and the drugs can go straight to Brian or Donnie.
IGN says a truck of armed men arrives soon after the loot is taken; their off-road truck can be taken for later drug recovery runs.

facts.location: Field south of Hamlet, Mariana County

name: Solo pool tables
summary: Ten of the 17 pool tables have no opponent; IGN says they are free to play and count as cleared once the 8-ball is potted.
body: IGN counts 17 pool tables, marked by a purple 8-ball icon; clicking a venue's map icon shows whether it has one, and all 17 are needed for 100%.
IGN says ten tables are for free solo play and are marked cleared once the 8-ball goes down.

IGN's Mariana County solo tables: under an awning by the dock outside the Isla Tropical Private Club, inside the Tiki Touchdown bar, beneath a white house at Cangrejo St and Queen Palm Ave in Southwind (filed as Riquezas Keys), and on the back patio of The White Clam restaurant.

IGN's Vice-Dale County solo tables: a first-floor balcony in the Carnegie Ivory Towers on Dalton Island, beside an ATM in the Tisha-Wocka Flea Market, the Grand Majestic Aparthotel lobby facing its gym, the middle roof of the Sumerian Hotel, and a back room of the Pegassi Residences penthouse.
IGN's one Leonard County solo table is in a first-floor room above the courtyard of the Sands of Time Assisted Living & Memory Care facility.
